CRL.M.C. 1999/2024 & CRL.M.A. 7796/2024 (exemption from filing ID proof and coloured photograph of R-2)
3. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. preferred on behalf of the Petitioners for quashing of FIR No.106/2018 dated 16.02.2018 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS: Narela.
4. Learned counsel for Petitioners states that the matter was amicably settled between Petitioners and Respondent No.2.
Divorce proceedings culminated into divorce by mutual consent and the settlement amount of Rs.1,00,000/- stands paid to Respondent No.2.
Despite the settlement and the divorce decree and having received the settlement amount, Respondent No.2 is now not cooperating in quashing of the present FIR.
